INSERT INTO marketing_task_target (marketing_task_id, account_id, account_phone, target_scope, group_link_id, group_jid, group_link_url, group_name, status, sent_message_count, failed_message_count, retry_count, last_attempt_at, last_sent_at, last_reason, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{marketingTaskId}, #{accountId}, #{accountPhone}, #{targetScope}, #{groupLinkId}, #{groupJid}, #{groupLinkUrl}, #{groupName}, #{status}, #{sentMessageCount}, #{failedMessageCount}, #{retryCount}, #{lastAttemptAt}, #{lastSentAt}, #{lastReason}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

SELECT t.account_id AS accountId, t.account_phone AS accountPhone, COALESCE(a.group_link_id, p.group_link_id, t.group_link_id) AS groupLinkId, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.group_jid), ''), t.group_jid) AS groupJid, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT( COALESCE(g.link_url, t.group_link_url) ORDER BY COALESCE(a.result_at, a.attempted_at, a.created_at) DESC SEPARATOR '
' ), '
', 1 ) AS groupLinkUrl, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT( COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(g.group_name), ''), p.wa_subject, t.group_name) ORDER BY COALESCE(a.result_at, a.attempted_at, a.created_at) DESC SEPARATOR '
' ), '
', 1 ) AS groupName, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sentMessageCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedMessageCount, MAX(COALESCE(a.result_at, a.attempted_at, a.created_at)) AS lastAttemptAt, MAX(CASE WHEN a.status = 1 THEN COALESCE(a.result_at, a.attempted_at, a.created_at) ELSE NULL END) AS lastSentAt, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN a.status = 2 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.reason_message), ''), a.reason_code, '发送失败') ELSE NULL END ORDER BY COALESCE(a.result_at, a.attempted_at, a.created_at) DESC SEPARATOR '
' ), '
', 1 ) AS lastReason FROM marketing_task_target t JOIN marketing_task_send_attempt a ON a.target_id = t.id AND a.marketing_task_id = t.marketing_task_id LEFT JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.group_link_id = COALESCE(a.group_link_id, t.group_link_id) LEFT JOIN group_link g ON g.id = COALESCE(a.group_link_id, p.group_link_id, t.group_link_id) WHERE t.marketing_task_id = #{taskId} AND a.marketing_task_id = #{taskId} AND a.status IN (1, 2) GROUP BY t.account_id, t.account_phone, COALESCE(a.group_link_id, p.group_link_id, t.group_link_id), COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.group_jid), ''), t.group_jid) ORDER BY t.account_id ASC, MAX(COALESCE(a.result_at, a.attempted_at, a.created_at)) DESC, COALESCE(a.group_link_id, p.group_link_id, t.group_link_id) ASC

INSERT INTO marketing_task_send_attempt (marketing_task_id, target_id, group_link_id, group_jid, group_name, round_no, attempt_no, is_retry, command_id, status, reason_code, reason_message, message_id, submitted_at, result_at, attempted_at, created_at) VALUES
(#{a.marketingTaskId}, #{a.targetId}, #{a.groupLinkId}, #{a.groupJid}, #{a.groupName}, #{a.roundNo}, #{a.attemptNo}, #{a.retry}, #{a.commandId}, #{a.status}, #{a.reasonCode}, #{a.reasonMessage}, #{a.messageId}, #{a.submittedAt}, #{a.resultAt}, #{a.attemptedAt}, #{a.createdAt})

INSERT INTO marketing_task_send_attempt (marketing_task_id, target_id, group_link_id, group_jid, group_name, round_no, attempt_no, is_retry, command_id, status, reason_code, reason_message, message_id, submitted_at, result_at, attempted_at, created_at) VALUES (#{marketingTaskId}, #{targetId}, #{groupLinkId}, #{groupJid}, #{groupName}, #{roundNo}, #{attemptNo}, #{retry}, #{commandId}, #{status}, #{reasonCode}, #{reasonMessage}, #{messageId}, #{submittedAt}, #{resultAt}, #{attemptedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_task_send_attempt SET status = 1, message_id = #{messageId}, group_jid = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(#{groupJid}), '')), result_at = #{resultAt} WHERE id = #{attemptId} AND status = 0

UPDATE marketing_task_send_attempt SET status = 2, reason_code = #{reasonCode}, reason_message = #{reasonMessage}, group_jid = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(#{groupJid}), '')), result_at = #{resultAt} WHERE id = #{attemptId} AND status = 0

UPDATE marketing_task SET sent_message_count = sent_message_count + #{successDelta}, failed_message_count = failed_message_count + #{failedDelta}, last_sent_at = CASE WHEN #{successDelta} > 0 THEN #{now} ELSE last_sent_at END, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE marketing_task_target t JOIN marketing_task_send_attempt a ON a.id = #{attemptId} AND a.target_id = t.id LEFT JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.group_jid = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), '')) LEFT JOIN group_link g ON g.id = COALESCE(a.group_link_id, p.group_link_id, t.group_link_id) SET t.group_link_id = COALESCE(a.group_link_id, p.group_link_id, t.group_link_id), t.group_jid = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.group_jid), ''), t.group_jid), t.group_link_url = COALESCE(g.link_url, t.group_link_url), t.group_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(g.group_name), ''), p.wa_subject, t.group_name), t.status = CASE WHEN t.failed_message_count > 0 THEN 5 ELSE 3 END, t.sent_message_count = t.sent_message_count + 1, t.last_attempt_at = #{resultAt}, t.last_sent_at = #{resultAt}, t.last_reason = CASE WHEN t.failed_message_count > 0 THEN t.last_reason ELSE NULL END, t.updated_at = #{resultAt} WHERE t.id = #{targetId}

UPDATE marketing_task_target t JOIN marketing_task_send_attempt a ON a.id = #{attemptId} AND a.target_id = t.id LEFT JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.group_jid = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), '')) LEFT JOIN group_link g ON g.id = COALESCE(a.group_link_id, p.group_link_id, t.group_link_id) SET t.group_link_id = COALESCE(a.group_link_id, p.group_link_id, t.group_link_id), t.group_jid = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.group_jid), ''), t.group_jid), t.group_link_url = COALESCE(g.link_url, t.group_link_url), t.group_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(g.group_name), ''), p.wa_subject, t.group_name), t.status = CASE WHEN t.sent_message_count > 0 THEN 5 ELSE 4 END, t.failed_message_count = t.failed_message_count + 1, t.last_attempt_at = #{resultAt}, t.last_reason = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{reasonMessage}), ''), #{reasonCode}, '发送失败'), t.updated_at = #{resultAt} WHERE t.id = #{targetId}
UPDATE marketing_task SET status = 2, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, #{now}), next_round_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status IN (1, 5)
UPDATE marketing_task SET status = 5, updated_at = #{now} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status IN (1, 2) AND marketing_template_id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marketing_task WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 2 AND id IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_task SET deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, updated_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status <> 2 AND id IN #{id}

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.ws_phone AS accountPhone, g.id AS groupLinkId, p.group_jid AS groupJid, g.link_url AS groupLinkUrl, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(g.group_name), ''), p.wa_subject) AS groupName FROM account a JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id JOIN group_link g ON g.id = #{groupLinkId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.group_link_id = g.id LEFT JOIN account_group_baseline b ON b.account_id = a.id AND a.group_baseline_state = 2 WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND a.account_group_id = #{accountGroupId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.login_state = 1 AND (s.risk_status IS NULL OR s.risk_status = 1) AND s.mute_status IS NULL AND p.group_jid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.group_jid) <> '' AND ( a.group_baseline_state <> 2 OR b.id IS NULL OR COALESCE(JSON_CONTAINS(b.baseline_group_jids, JSON_QUOTE(p.group_jid)), 0) = 0 ) LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.ws_phone AS accountPhone FROM account a JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND a.account_group_id = #{accountGroupId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.login_state = 1 AND (s.risk_status IS NULL OR s.risk_status = 1) AND s.mute_status IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.ws_phone AS accountPhone, m.group_link_id AS groupLinkId, m.group_jid AS groupJid, g.link_url AS groupLinkUrl, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(g.group_name), ''), p.wa_subject) AS groupName FROM account a JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id JOIN account_group_membership m ON m.account_id = a.id JOIN group_link g ON g.id = m.group_link_id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND g.membership_state IN (2, 3) LEFT JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.group_link_id = g.id AND p.group_jid = m.group_jid LEFT JOIN group_link_health h ON h.group_link_id = g.id LEFT JOIN account_group_baseline b ON b.account_id = a.id AND a.group_baseline_state = 2 WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.login_state = 1 AND (s.risk_status IS NULL OR s.risk_status = 1) AND s.mute_status IS NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.group_jid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(m.group_jid) <> '' AND (h.id IS NULL OR (COALESCE(h.is_banned, 0) = 0 AND (h.health_status IS NULL OR h.health_status = 1))) AND ( a.group_baseline_state <> 2 OR b.id IS NULL OR COALESCE(JSON_CONTAINS(b.baseline_group_jids, JSON_QUOTE(m.group_jid)), 0) = 0 ) ORDER BY m.group_link_id ASC

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, a.group_baseline_state AS groupBaselineState, b.baseline_group_jids AS baselineGroupJidsJson FROM account a JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN account_group_baseline b ON b.account_id = a.id WHERE a.account_group_id = #{groupId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id) <> '' AND s.login_state = 1 AND (s.risk_status IS NULL OR s.risk_status = 1) AND s.mute_status IS NULL ORDER BY a.id ASC

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, a.group_baseline_state AS groupBaselineState, b.baseline_group_jids AS baselineGroupJidsJson FROM account a JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN account_group_baseline b ON b.account_id = a.id WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id) <> '' AND s.login_state = 1 AND (s.risk_status IS NULL OR s.risk_status = 1) AND s.mute_status IS NULL LIMIT 1
